questions.explanation: PTX has unlimited virtual registers; ptxas maps them to the real register file.

questions.prompt: Why ship PTX in a binary as well as SASS?
options: The driver can JIT-compile it for GPUs that didn't exist when the binary was built
questions.explanation: PTX is the portable, forward-compatible contract.

questions.prompt: How many instructions does a code generator with fma selection need for x*y + z*w (x, y, z, w in registers, result into a fresh register)?
questions.explanation: mul t, z, w; fma out, x, y, t.

questions.prompt: Why can a GPU result differ from a CPU result in the last bits for the same source?
options: FMA contraction rounds once where separate multiply and add round twice
questions.explanation: Fusing changes rounding; nvcc fuses by default.

questions.prompt: Which tools show you what the GPU actually executes?
questions.explanation: PTX is still virtual; SASS is what runs.
